values.meaning: duration a blade stays active before auto-recast
values.quote: '''Irelia''' sends a blade to the target location for {{fd|3.5}} seconds

values.meaning: minimum time before recast is allowed
values.quote: can be recast after {{fd|0.15}} seconds while the blade is active
values.binNote: Wiki states 0.15s minimum recast delay; bin's IreliaE.CDBetweenCast is 0.25, a differing value for what may be the same or a related restriction.

values.meaning: convergence travel time before stun/damage lands
values.binNote: Wiki's convergence time of 0.25s matches IreliaE.RevTime=0.35 in neither value; no bin row directly states 0.25, closest is RevTime (0.35) which disagrees.

mechanics.claim: The ability deals damage and stuns only when both blades converge; it does not damage on the initial cast.
mechanics.quote: afterwards dealing {{as|magic damage}} to all enemies within a line between them and {{tip|stun|stunning}} them

mechanics.claim: If the converging blades are destroyed by a projectile-blocking effect before meeting, no damage or stun occurs.
mechanics.quote: The blades will not stun nor deal damage if they fail to converge

mechanics.claim: Both the initial cast and the recast each independently count as an ability activation, triggering on-cast effects like Spellblade twice.
mechanics.quote: Both casts count as an ability activation for the purposes of on-cast effects such as {{tip|Spellblade}}

mechanics.claim: If not manually recast, the automatic secondary cast still counts as an ability activation.
mechanics.quote: If the ability is not manually recasted, the secondary effect will trigger and it will be considered as an ability activation

mechanics.claim: The ability has no cast time on either the initial cast or the recast.
The cooldown begins only after the full effect (both blades converging) resolves, not on initial cast.
